media.alt_text: Towering green stalks of the Arashiyama Bamboo Forest in Kyoto

caption.body: Arashiyama Bamboo Forest in Kyoto — towering bamboo, filtered light, and surprisingly quiet if you go early enough. One of those places that lives up to the photos.
